Specification: This module is a test specification for TLA+ labels and subexpression selectors, rather than a protocol or transition system. It defines many small operators that exercise labels, LET/IN bindings, higher-order operator parameters, CHOOSE, set comprehensions, function constructors, EXCEPT, records, tuples, quantified formulas, CASE, IF, and temporal subscript syntax, primarily to validate parsing and selector behavior. The file includes a couple of trivial theorems and an instance of another module, but it does not model mutable state, faults, or a temporal system execution; instead it systematically covers many syntactic forms of TLA+ expressions.
IfThenElse: IF TRUE THEN LET Op1a(c) == 4 * c + a*x IN a + Op1a(x) ELSE 1
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE x : lab(x) ::  LET a ++ b ==  {a, b, q, p, x}
                         IN  <<q, 99 ++ p >>

CHOOSE x : lab(x) ::  LET a ++ b ==  {lab(y):: y + a + b : y \in {1}}
                         IN  <<q, 99 ++ p >>
